title: Sum Of Subsequence Widths
description:
The width of a nonempty sequence is its maximum element minus its minimum element. Given `nums`, return the sum of widths of all nonempty subsequences, modulo `10^9 + 7`.

A subsequence is obtained by keeping a nonempty set of indices in their original order. Different index selections count separately, even when their values are equal.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: nums = [2, 1, 3]
Output: 6
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: nums = [2]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= nums.length <= 10^5
- 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^5
